name: LinkedIn Recruiter: location typeahead PROBE (read-only, no search)
description: Diagnostic. Opens the advanced-search LOCATION facet and types each place in `location` (";"-separated), REPORTING what the typeahead offers for it — committing nothing and running NO search. This is how we learn which geo names Recruiter actually accepts without spending a real search on the sensitive account; it is the tool that would have caught `latam` being sent as "Latin America" (a name the candidate-location typeahead does not offer), which made those runs source worldwide. Read the run's `apply_locations_result.suggestions`. Params: location.

steps.intent: Probe the location typeahead (dry run — selects nothing)
